How to Use Export Builder

  1. 1. Select a metadata type and search for specific items
  2. 2. Click items to add them to your export list
  3. 3. (Optional) Click "Add All Dependencies" to include related metadata
  4. 4. Download as CSV (for spreadsheets, Lucidchart) or JSON (for developers)
